full_judgment: 5. The above submission has been made in respect of both the Rules. So let us consider this contention first. Under the provisions of section 4 of Muslim Marriage and Divorce Registration Act 1974 hereinafter referred to as the Act, Government have been empowered to grant licence to the Nikah Registrar. Proviso to the section authorised Government to extend, curtail or otherwise alter the limitation of any area of which a Nikah Registrar has been licensed.
